embodiment: Unitree G1 with a five-finger Inspire right hand; fixed pelvis on a stand

hand.license: Apache-2.0 repository license; preserve upstream asset notices
hand.conversion: MuJoCo URDF importer; retain meshes, inertias, axes and limits; strip non-mesh coordinate/tip visualization markers; reconstruct native URDF mimic relationships as joint equalities

simulation_adaptations.mount: Official G1 DFQ R_base_link_joint: xyz [0.0415, 0, 0] m, rpy [pi, 0, -pi/2]; quaternion wxyz [0, 0.70710678, -0.70710678, 0]
simulation_adaptations.hand_servo: Position kp 4, kv 0.12; effort capped at +/-1 Nm per driven joint; dynamics not system identified
simulation_adaptations.finger_contact: Native converted hand collision geometry retained; new full-video trajectory has not been physically validated.
simulation_adaptations.body: Native G1 geometry, joints and effort caps; supported fixed pelvis, no walking or balance claim

runtime: Separate .venv-g1, MuJoCo 3.8.1, scipy 1.18.1; Apple Silicon CPU physics and local OpenGL rendering
camera: Torso/head-mounted egocentric camera aligned with the reconstructed phone camera; no image mirroring.
